pages.title: 2: Жатва душ
pages.text: Okay champ, to finish the $(item)Black Hole Containment Vessel$() we need something called a $(item)Soul Crystal$().$(br2)The details of how we create them is not all that important. But for now all you need to know is that you need $(item)8million LP$() in your network and a few other things to manufacture a $(item)Celestial Soul Tether$().

Once you have the $(item)Celestial Soul Tether$(), you will need to perform another $(l:sim_4/6_meteor)Mark of the Falling Tower$() ritual.$(br2)Activate the ritual with the $(item)Awakened Activation Crystal$() and place the $(item)Celestial Soul Tether$() on the $(item)Master Ritual Stone$(), then stand back.

pages.title: Bash the blue stuff
pages.text: Once the ritual is complete, use your hammer on the blue-ish crystal blocks that appeared.$(br2)Then collect the dropped clusters. $(br2)$(italic)We still urge you to not put too much thought into what it is that you are doing.$()

pages.title: Infuse the Crystal
pages.text: Before you can make the $(item)Soul Crystals$(), you have to infuse the clusters with $(item)Soul Vials$() containing $(item)Rifter$() souls in the $(item)Soul Binder$().

pages.title: Finish the Crystal
pages.text: Once the cluster is infused, you can use it with some $(item)Void Crystals$() in the $(item)Slice N Splice$() to make the $(item)Soul Crystals$().
